name: Back from a long lock: one reaction, the welcome back
case: The person locks the Mac, is gone three hours and unlocks it. Boop plays one reaction, the welcome back: the lock's wave when they left, and at the end only the back's, never another for the unlock itself. It wakes up for them.
why: An unlock ending an away makes no line of its own, so one reaction. The view holds it, so no Jev is needed
